verdict.rationale: A guided first-time workspace setup walkthrough is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Shortcut, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no in-product onboarding flow or walkthrough for setting up a new workspace. The nearest items are an integration-specific setup guide for Codex CLI via MCP and Jira/Trello/CSV import paths. Both are adjacent features, not a guided workspace-setup walkthrough.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
